findings.evidence: validate_supervision currently trusts ACTIVE JSON fields and process IDs. No supervisor implementation is present among the five files; no actual executable/argv/source hash/start-ticks/GNUtime FD/inode proof or real group watchdog/reap evidence exists yet.
findings.remedy: Implement a versioned thin port of the already reviewed engineering supervision/lifecycle and review it together with the build protocol before freezing.

findings.evidence: validate_prior checks execution set, ledger SHA and scalar charged totals but does not validate each external replacement POST/timing/receipt SHA or select/assert the latest authoritative ledger. This is weaker than the reviewed SBL current_prior gate.
findings.remedy: Reuse the existing latest-ledger plus independently qualified external-cost validation, retaining every actual execution and orphan attempt once.

findings.evidence: The finally branch saves provisional wall/CPU only. Source/staged/dependency/protocol/prior after-hashes and compiler group empty/reap proof are absent on failure, while invoke subprocess.run alone cannot account for live child CPU or prove all compiler grandchildren ended.
findings.remedy: Keep current failure logs and add reviewed all-exit source/hash preservation and group reaping under real external 45W/90CPU supervision; no retry.

findings.evidence: Requests are empty and caps/prior null, honestly not executable. Header caps are per process, while the 512 project proposal applies to both plain and trace together; aggregate accounting and the complete endpoint/role/branch dependency schedule remain future work.
findings.remedy: Freeze exact ordered requests with total public18 per binary and 36 together, 512 aggregate internal project cap, all source entries counted, unchanged thresholds and no failed fixture replacement.

findings.evidence: Driver rejects forward/missing/type/role/branch mismatched references before constructing the model. It intentionally does not infer a center identity from q12 or require two endpoints distinct; the eventual frozen source schedule must prove these exact fixture properties.
findings.remedy: Bind both A02 center inputs and explicit identify/project reference IDs, exact active first-joint ±.05 changes, same-center/role/branch references, finite returned q12 and independent post checks without adding new queries.

limitations: This is an independent static review, not an executable freeze certificate.
No C++ compiler/typechecker, model, collision, projection, RBS, solve or formal trial was run.
The first independent checker missed int in its regex; failure retained separately, closeout used the same already saved five outputs without re-transform.
All necessary candidate changes are assigned to the V implementation agent; SBL local/solve sources were not edited.
